title: Knowledge base
content:
# Knowledge base

Search every Zernio guide in one place, from connecting accounts and uploading media to webhooks, security, integrations and migrations.

- Guides: Accounts, media, scheduling, errors and rate limits.
- Webhooks: The events Zernio sends and the payload of each one.
- Build a platform: Post, message and report on behalf of your customers.
- AI and terminal: The MCP server and the CLI.
- Security: SSO, SCIM and two-factor authentication.
- Integrations: n8n, Make, Zapier and other tools.
- Migrations: Move to Zernio from another provider.
